content.text:
A signed-in member submitting the new-issue form ends at one `issues` row, optional `issue_labels` rows, then four in-process reactions: an audit row, a search document, a usage counter bump, and pending webhook deliveries. No notification is written on this path.

## Browser

The page at `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/issues/new/page.tsx` renders `IssueForm` (`src/components/domain/issue/issue-form.tsx`) with `onSubmit={createIssueAction}`. The form is a client component. `useForm` validates with `zodResolver(createIssueSchema)` from `src/schemas/issue.ts` before anything is posted. `createIssueSchema` requires a ULID `orgId` and `projectId`, a title of 3–200 characters, an optional description up to 20,000 characters, `status` and `priority` enums (defaults `backlog` and `none`), a nullable `assigneeId`, `parentId`, `estimate` (0–100), `dueAt`, and at most 20 `labelIds`. The page seeds `status` from `org.settings.defaultIssueStatus` through `defaultStatusFor`, falling back to `"backlog"`. The visible fields do not include estimate or parent, so those stay `null`.

`form.handleSubmit` calls `submit` from `useFormAction` (`src/hooks/use-form-action.ts`), which invokes the Server Action `createIssueAction` in `src/actions/issues/create-issue.ts`. The action is marked `"use server"`.

The POST also passes `proxy` in `src/proxy.ts`. That function only checks that the `taskflow_session` cookie exists on a non-public path. It does not look up the session or the membership.

## The action wrapper

`createIssueAction` delegates to `run`, built by `withAction` in `src/actions/_lib/with-action.ts`. `withAction` does four things in order.

1. `createIssueSchema.safeParse(raw)`. A failed parse becomes `toActionResult` (`src/lib/errors.ts`), an `ActionResult` with `code: "validation_failed"` and `fieldErrors`. `stamp` adds `submittedAt`.

2. `resolveActorFor`. The payload has `orgId` and no `orgSlug`, so this calls `requireActorFor` in `src/lib/actor.ts`.
   - `getSessionPrincipal` (`src/lib/session.ts`) reads the `taskflow_session` cookie, hashes it with `hashToken`, and loads it through `resolveSession` → `sessionRepo.findSessionByTokenHash`. A missing cookie, an unknown token, or an expiry at or before `Date.now()` yields `null`, and `requireActorFor` throws `UnauthorizedError`.
   - A principal whose `activeOrgId` is `null` throws `NoMembershipError`.
   - `findOrgById` loads the organization. A missing org throws `NoMembershipError`.
   - `resolveActorForOrg` (`src/server/services/session-service.ts`) loads the org by slug, then `memberRepo.findMember`. The member must exist and have `status === "active"`. It builds an `Actor` (`userId`, `orgId`, `role` from `src/types/member.ts`), calls `assertOrgScope`, and `memberRepo.touchLastSeen`. A non-member returns `null`, which becomes `NoMembershipError`.
   - `requireActorFor` calls `assertOrgScope(actor, orgId)` again. That compares `actor.orgId` to the payload `orgId`. It does not compare `principal.activeOrgId` to the payload.

3. The handler runs. Any throw is caught and passed to `toActionResult`. `toAppError` maps `ZodError`, `PermissionDeniedError`, `TenantScopeError`, `AlreadyArchivedError`, `FeatureDisabledError`, and `InvalidSlugError` onto their `ErrorCode`s. `PlanLimitError`, `ForbiddenActionError`, `UnauthorizedError`, `NoMembershipError`, and `NotFoundError` fall through to `code: "internal_error"` with the error message kept. The client only displays `error.message` in `ErrorMessage`. On `{ ok: true }`, `IssueForm` resets the form.

4. After a successful handler, `withAction` calls `revalidateTagged(["issues"], "minutes")`.

## Gates inside the handler

The handler in `createIssueAction` runs three checks before it returns the issue.

**Permission, before the service.** `can(actor, "issue:create", …)` in `src/lib/permissions.ts` is called with a synthetic issue resource: `kind: "issue"`, the payload `orgId` and `projectId`, `issueId: ""`, `authorId: actor.userId`, and the chosen `assigneeId`. `explain` decides in this order: `actor.orgId` must equal `resource.orgId` (`denied_cross_tenant` otherwise); `isPlatformStaff` would allow it, but `resolveActorForOrg` never sets that flag; `ROLE_MATRIX["issue:create"]` is `"member"`, so `ROLE_RANK` must be at least member (owner, admin, member). `issue:create` is not in `OWNERSHIP_ESCALATIONS`, so being the prospective author or assignee does not help a viewer. A denial throws `ForbiddenActionError`.

**Plan quota, action layer.** `assertProjectHasRoom` calls `getOrganizationSummary` (`src/server/services/organization-service.ts`), which itself runs `assertOrgScope`, `assertCan(actor, "org:read", …)` (viewer and above), and loads the org, usage, member count, and project count. `getPlanLimits(summary.organization.plan)` in `src/config/plan-limits.ts` supplies `issuesPerProject`: 100 (free), 1,000 (starter), 10,000 (growth), or unlimited (enterprise). Then `listIssues` (`issue-service`) runs `assertOrgScope` and `assertCan(actor, "issue:read", orgResource)` and asks `issueRepo.listIssues` with `includeArchived: true` and `limit: 1`. The repository count in `issueFilters` includes archived rows because `shouldFilterArchived` is false. If `existing.total >= limits.issuesPerProject`, it throws `PlanLimitError("issuesPerProject", limit, total)`.

**Service write.** `createIssue(actor, input)` in `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` applies its own gates, in order:

1. `assertOrgScope(actor, input.orgId)` (`src/lib/tenant.ts`). A mismatch throws `TenantScopeError`.
2. `projectRepo.findProjectById(input.orgId, input.projectId)`, then `requireFound` (`src/server/services/_support.ts`). A miss throws `NotFoundError`.
3. `assertNotArchived("Project", project.id, project)` (`src/lib/soft-delete.ts`). An `archivedAt` timestamp throws `AlreadyArchivedError`.
4. `assertCan(actor, "issue:create", projectResource(project))`. This resource has `kind: "project"` (org, project, visibility, lead). The same role matrix applies. A denial throws `PermissionDeniedError`, which `toAppError` maps to `forbidden`.
5. `orgRepo.findOrgById` plus `requireFound`.
6. A second quota check: `issueRepo.countIssues(orgId, projectId)` with the default archive scope, so only live rows (`archived_at IS NULL`). `wouldExceedLimit(org.plan, "issuesPerProject", used)` throws a plain `Error` when `used + 1` is above the plan ceiling. The action’s count already includes archived rows, so this live-only check is the looser of the two when both run.
7. `issueRepo.nextIssueNumber` takes `max(issues.number)` over every row in the project, archived included, and adds 1. The unique index is `issues_project_number_idx` on `(project_id, number)`.

Nothing on this path checks that `parentId` or `labelIds` refer to live rows in the same org, and the description is not scanned for mentions.

## The database row

`issueRepo.insertIssue` (`src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`) writes through Drizzle on better-sqlite3 (`getDb()`). `newId()` (`src/lib/id.ts`) mints a ULID. One `issues` insert (`src/server/db/schema/issues.ts`) sets `id`, `org_id`, `project_id`, `number`, `title`, `description`, `status`, `priority`, `author_id` from `actor.userId`, `assignee_id`, `parent_id`, `estimate`, `due_at`, `started_at` and `completed_at` as null, and `created_at` / `updated_at` to the same ISO timestamp. `archived_at` stays null. `.returning().get()` reads the row back.

If `labelIds` is non-empty, a second insert writes one `issue_labels` row per id (`org_id`, `issue_id`, `label_id`). The two writes are not wrapped in a transaction. `toIssue` (`src/server/repositories/_mappers.ts`) brands the ids and attaches `labelIds`, producing the `Issue` returned to the client.

## After the row

`createIssue` then `await emit("issue.created", …)` (`src/lib/event-bus.ts`). `actorEnvelope` stamps `orgId`, `actorId`, and `occurredAt`. The payload type is `TaskflowEventMap["issue.created"]` in `src/types/event.ts`: `issueId`, `projectId`, `title`, `assigneeId`, `priority`. `emit` runs every subscriber with `Promise.allSettled`. A handler that throws is reported to error sinks and does not fail the action or the other handlers.

## Browser

The page at `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/issues/new/page.tsx` renders `IssueForm` (`src/components/domain/issue/issue-form.tsx`) with `onSubmit={createIssueAction}`. The form is a client component. `useForm` validates with `zodResolver(createIssueSchema)` from `src/schemas/issue.ts` before anything is posted. `createIssueSchema` requires a ULID `orgId` and `projectId`, a title of 3–200 characters, an optional description up to 20,000 characters, `status` and `priority` enums (defaults `backlog` and `none`), a nullable `assigneeId`, `parentId`, `estimate` (0–100), `dueAt`, and at most 20 `labelIds`. The page seeds `status` from `org.settings.defaultIssueStatus` through `defaultStatusFor`, falling back to `"backlog"`. The visible fields do not include estimate or parent, so those stay `null`.

`form.handleSubmit` calls `submit` from `useFormAction` (`src/hooks/use-form-action.ts`), which invokes the Server Action `createIssueAction` in `src/actions/issues/create-issue.ts`. The action is marked `"use server"`.

The POST also passes `proxy` in `src/proxy.ts`. That function only checks that the `taskflow_session` cookie exists on a non-public path. It does not look up the session or the membership.

## The action wrapper

`createIssueAction` delegates to `run`, built by `withAction` in `src/actions/_lib/with-action.ts`. `withAction` does four things in order.

1. `createIssueSchema.safeParse(raw)`. A failed parse becomes `toActionResult` (`src/lib/errors.ts`), an `ActionResult` with `code: "validation_failed"` and `fieldErrors`. `stamp` adds `submittedAt`.

2. `resolveActorFor`. The payload has `orgId` and no `orgSlug`, so this calls `requireActorFor` in `src/lib/actor.ts`.
   - `getSessionPrincipal` (`src/lib/session.ts`) reads the `taskflow_session` cookie, hashes it with `hashToken`, and loads it through `resolveSession` → `sessionRepo.findSessionByTokenHash`. A missing cookie, an unknown token, or an expiry at or before `Date.now()` yields `null`, and `requireActorFor` throws `UnauthorizedError`.
   - A principal whose `activeOrgId` is `null` throws `NoMembershipError`.
   - `findOrgById` loads the organization. A missing org throws `NoMembershipError`.
   - `resolveActorForOrg` (`src/server/services/session-service.ts`) loads the org by slug, then `memberRepo.findMember`. The member must exist and have `status === "active"`. It builds an `Actor` (`userId`, `orgId`, `role` from `src/types/member.ts`), calls `assertOrgScope`, and `memberRepo.touchLastSeen`. A non-member returns `null`, which becomes `NoMembershipError`.
   - `requireActorFor` calls `assertOrgScope(actor, orgId)` again. That compares `actor.orgId` to the payload `orgId`. It does not compare `principal.activeOrgId` to the payload.

3. The handler runs. Any throw is caught and passed to `toActionResult`. `toAppError` maps `ZodError`, `PermissionDeniedError`, `TenantScopeError`, `AlreadyArchivedError`, `FeatureDisabledError`, and `InvalidSlugError` onto their `ErrorCode`s. `PlanLimitError`, `ForbiddenActionError`, `UnauthorizedError`, `NoMembershipError`, and `NotFoundError` fall through to `code: "internal_error"` with the error message kept. The client only displays `error.message` in `ErrorMessage`. On `{ ok: true }`, `IssueForm` resets the form.

4. After a successful handler, `withAction` calls `revalidateTagged(["issues"], "minutes")`.

## Gates inside the handler

The handler in `createIssueAction` runs three checks before it returns the issue.

**Permission, before the service.** `can(actor, "issue:create", …)` in `src/lib/permissions.ts` is called with a synthetic issue resource: `kind: "issue"`, the payload `orgId` and `projectId`, `issueId: ""`, `authorId: actor.userId`, and the chosen `assigneeId`. `explain` decides in this order: `actor.orgId` must equal `resource.orgId` (`denied_cross_tenant` otherwise); `isPlatformStaff` would allow it, but `resolveActorForOrg` never sets that flag; `ROLE_MATRIX["issue:create"]` is `"member"`, so `ROLE_RANK` must be at least member (owner, admin, member). `issue:create` is not in `OWNERSHIP_ESCALATIONS`, so being the prospective author or assignee does not help a viewer. A denial throws `ForbiddenActionError`.

**Plan quota, action layer.** `assertProjectHasRoom` calls `getOrganizationSummary` (`src/server/services/organization-service.ts`), which itself runs `assertOrgScope`, `assertCan(actor, "org:read", …)` (viewer and above), and loads the org, usage, member count, and project count. `getPlanLimits(summary.organization.plan)` in `src/config/plan-limits.ts` supplies `issuesPerProject`: 100 (free), 1,000 (starter), 10,000 (growth), or unlimited (enterprise). Then `listIssues` (`issue-service`) runs `assertOrgScope` and `assertCan(actor, "issue:read", orgResource)` and asks `issueRepo.listIssues` with `includeArchived: true` and `limit: 1`. The repository count in `issueFilters` includes archived rows because `shouldFilterArchived` is false. If `existing.total >= limits.issuesPerProject`, it throws `PlanLimitError("issuesPerProject", limit, total)`.

**Service write.** `createIssue(actor, input)` in `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` applies its own gates, in order:

1. `assertOrgScope(actor, input.orgId)` (`src/lib/tenant.ts`). A mismatch throws `TenantScopeError`.
2. `projectRepo.findProjectById(input.orgId, input.projectId)`, then `requireFound` (`src/server/services/_support.ts`). A miss throws `NotFoundError`.
3. `assertNotArchived("Project", project.id, project)` (`src/lib/soft-delete.ts`). An `archivedAt` timestamp throws `AlreadyArchivedError`.
4. `assertCan(actor, "issue:create", projectResource(project))`. This resource has `kind: "project"` (org, project, visibility, lead). The same role matrix applies. A denial throws `PermissionDeniedError`, which `toAppError` maps to `forbidden`.
5. `orgRepo.findOrgById` plus `requireFound`.
6. A second quota check: `issueRepo.countIssues(orgId, projectId)` with the default archive scope, so only live rows (`archived_at IS NULL`). `wouldExceedLimit(org.plan, "issuesPerProject", used)` throws a plain `Error` when `used + 1` is above the plan ceiling. The action’s count already includes archived rows, so this live-only check is the looser of the two when both run.
7. `issueRepo.nextIssueNumber` takes `max(issues.number)` over every row in the project, archived included, and adds 1. The unique index is `issues_project_number_idx` on `(project_id, number)`.

Nothing on this path checks that `parentId` or `labelIds` refer to live rows in the same org, and the description is not scanned for mentions.

## The database row

`issueRepo.insertIssue` (`src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`) writes through Drizzle on better-sqlite3 (`getDb()`). `newId()` (`src/lib/id.ts`) mints a ULID. One `issues` insert (`src/server/db/schema/issues.ts`) sets `id`, `org_id`, `project_id`, `number`, `title`, `description`, `status`, `priority`, `author_id` from `actor.userId`, `assignee_id`, `parent_id`, `estimate`, `due_at`, `started_at` and `completed_at` as null, and `created_at` / `updated_at` to the same ISO timestamp. `archived_at` stays null. `.returning().get()` reads the row back.

If `labelIds` is non-empty, a second insert writes one `issue_labels` row per id (`org_id`, `issue_id`, `label_id`). The two writes are not wrapped in a transaction. `toIssue` (`src/server/repositories/_mappers.ts`) brands the ids and attaches `labelIds`, producing the `Issue` returned to the client.
